thread:
maya: Heads-up: thinking about how we show runtime errors in the Console and API surface. Current console just shows "Error" and a stack, which confuses customers — they can't tell quota vs routing vs model mismatch. Proposal: add a short badging taxonomy (type + severity) + a one-line customer hint.

sam: +1. We need both the console badge and the API hint so clients can programmatically react. Suggest buckets: `quota_limit`, `soft_degrade`, `model_mismatch`, `backend_unavailable`, `input_error`. Each bucket -> HTTP status mapping and a customer-facing `hint` string.

pri: For UX, keep hints very concise, actionable. Examples: "quota_limit: request rate exceeded — reduce batch size or contact sales" or "soft_degrade: reduced quality fallback applied — try a different model if accuracy matters". Avoid technical jargon.

leo: Telemetry note: if we expose buckets in API we must ensure no PII or sensitive internal signals leak. Also need stable enums for dashboards and sampling so alerts don't flip during rollouts.

maya: Good call, leo. Thinking of an enum field `error_reason` (stable) + `client_hint` (string). API sample: 

```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-Redwood-Error-Reason: quota_limit
{
  "error": "rate limit exceeded",
  "hint": "reduce QPS or apply backoff; see /docs/quotas"
}
```

sam: That looks fine. One open question: do we always map `quota_limit` to 429? sometimes we want 200 with `soft_degrade` and an explicit badge in body to avoid breaking old clients.

pri: UX preference: prefer non-breaking for conservative rollouts. For soft degrade send 200 with `warning` field and a console banner. For hard quota send 429. Keep the console and SDK mirrors consistent.

leo: Implementation caveat: our routing policies sometimes auto-fallback to a cheaper model and return 200. We need the runtime to annotate those responses with `degrade_type=auto_fallback` and record telemetry label `route_fallback=true` so dashboards can surface the cause.

maya: Agreed. We should standardize keys: `error_reason` (enum or null), `degrade_type` (enum or null), `warning` (short text), `trace_id`. And a console badge computed from these.

sam: +1 on fields. For rollouts: start with Console-only badging behind a feature flag, then SDK exposure in opt-in mode, then final API contract. Rollout checklist: docs, SDK patch, backend flag, dashboard alerts.

pri: Copy examples for Console: short badge text, color mapping: quota_limit -> red, soft_degrade -> orange, model_mismatch -> purple, backend_unavailable -> gray. Add hover text with longer explanation and link to runbook.

leo: Telemetry queries I need: counts by `error_reason` per minute, misrouted requests (where routing_policy != final_policy), and metric for `client_hint_shown` vs `client_hint_ignored` (from UI tracking). Will share dashboards after we lock fields.

maya: Action items:
- sam: draft HTTP mapping doc (429 vs 200 semantics) by EOD Thu
- pri: Console badge visual samples and copy by Fri
- leo: telemetry query templates + sampling plan by Mon
- maya: propose enums and API examples, add to RFC draft

deploy-bot: Deploy started: eng-platform/console-badging v0.1 -> staging (build 0a9c).

sam: Thanks — we'll iterate. if anyone has objections to the enum names or mapping please shout now, otherwise I'll put up the PR.
